_comment: BACKFILL built on 2026-10-12 for a week the scheduled routine missed (24 Aug - 5 Oct it could not push). Every value is point-in-time as of the report's Friday close; the build cuts the Shiller CSV and FRED data at the report date. The Buffett indicator has no dated gurufocus reading in this span, so it is carried from the previous report and marked stale.

spx_current.source: S&P 500 close 2026-09-11, +65.28 (+0.9%), August CPI release day (https://www.lanacion.com.ar/usa/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-friday-9112026-nid11092026/)

cpi_fallback.source: August 2026 CPI +0.4% m/m, +3.4% y/y, core +0.3% m/m (released 2026-09-11; third-party summary, not yet checked against BLS)

fred_fallback.source: FRED series via equibles.com mirrors, all for 2026-09-11: DGS10 4.96%, T10Y2Y +0.33, HY OAS 2.65% = 265bps

fiscal.source: CBO August Monthly Budget Review (09-09): $2.0tn deficit over the first 11 months of FY2026, consistent with the ~5.8% full-year projection. CRFB puts the 12-month rolling deficit at ~5.5% of GDP. Debt/GDP 122.6% is the Q1-2026 GFDEGDQ188S print
